newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - i-STAT EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - i-STAT EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney trimmed its 1997 earnings estimates on i-STAT Corp to a loss of $1.18 per share from a loss of $0.79 a share, a Smith Barney source said.
-- Smith Barney trimmed the 1998 earnings estimate to a loss of $0.36 a share from a profit of $0.60 a share, a Smith Barney source said.
-- i-STAT posted a loss of $1.31 a share for the year ended Dec 31, 1996.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- i-STAT, which makes medical diagnostic products for blood analysis, fell 8-1/8 to 19-1/8 in late afternoon exchange trading.
